 Phoenix Suns Golden State Warriors The Phoenix Suns and Golden State Warriors are just hours away from tip at Chase Center, and after the home team got a nice boost on their injury report, many believe the Warriors are set to continue their current winning streak.

 The visiting Suns hope to tell another story, though they've struggled to be consistent to begin the 2026-27 season.

 Spread: Suns +3.5
--> Spread: Suns +3.5
 Action Network : "The Suns open the 2026-27 campaign with an 0-4 record against the spread. The market has cooled significantly on them after another failure to beat the number last week. Yet, the underlying offensive production remains competitive. Devin Booker and Jalen Green continue to put up points in bunches.
